2026-11-14.title: Video - Sebastian Aho Goes Full Circle, Scoring On 10th Anniversary Of First Career Goal While In Finland
2026-11-14.summary: The Finnish superstar fueled Carolina’s victory in Helsinki, torching Philipp Grubauer for two historic goals while surpassing Olli Jokinen and matching Eric Staal on the franchise leaderboard.
